answer: A just-culture incident pipeline logs each new agent's first actions into a nebula of shared telemetry, flagging anomalies before trust accrues. Like an orchard tagging each tree, the system binds identity to a staked bond plus a tracked behavioral hazard register, so a sybil must fund and sustain many distinct histories. A raven of risk review escalates repeat offenders to quarantine, costing attackers bond forfeiture and rebuilt reputation; the limit is patient, well-funded slow-drip infiltration.
